fn: Restoring a backup (file or pasted text) now updates holes that are already in the notebook: status (ONGOING / TERMINATED) and Drill start and Drill complete dates come from the backup. Before, only holes the notebook did not have yet were taken from the backup, so a hole terminated in DS stayed ONGOING in FN. A packet that says a hole is TERMINATED also marks it terminated.
ds: Restoring a backup or importing a packet now updates the status and dates of holes that already exist (see FN note).
